notes.title: March 19 update details!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/967543233add383e4d4ab2e31a8ba392114c217a.jpg[/img]
We're announcing the contents of our March 19 update!

[h2]Update[/h2]
◆Added 2 new chapters for Main Story Part 2
◆Additional Core Slot Feature
◆Twin Core Feature

[h2]◆Added 2 new chapters for Main Story Part 2[/h2]
*There are no voices in this quest.


[h2]Additional Core Slot Feature[/h2]
This feature allows you to add core slots to some equipment beyond the maximum limit.
Equipment has 0-5 core slots, but the number can be increased by using a special drill.

[h2]About the necessary items to open additional core slots[/h2]
You need a special "Bore Drill" to open additional core slots.
You can get Bore Drills for example from Twin Grande Gacha.


[h2]About Bore Drill types[/h2]
There are several types and rarities of the Bore Drill.
The type and rarity of the drill affect the equipment it can open and the success rate of slot expansion.

Ex)
・Bore Drill+ [1H Sword]: You can open an additional core slot in a random color on the selected "1H Sword" at a 100% probability.
・Bore Drill [Staff]: You can open an additional slot in a random color on a "Staff" at a 10% probability.

[h2]About the equipment in which you can open additional core slots[/h2]
You can open an additional core slot on the following equipment.

・Some Legendary weapons
・Some UR equipment (head, top, bottoms)

[h2]How to open additional core slots[/h2]
You can use this feature by talking to NPC Sumina in the Enhancement Center after clearing the sub-quest "Enhancement Center".

You can get to the Enhancement Center from the southern border (on the State of Abul side).
You can also access it from YOME > Gear Enhancement > Open Slots menu.


[h2]About Twin Cores[/h2]
This item is combined by two colors, such as Red+Red or Red+Blue.
Unlike standard cores, Twin Cores take up two adjacent core slots when set, but they offer incredibly powerful effects.

You can get Twin Cores for example from Twin Grande Gacha.

[h2]How to set Twin Cores[/h2]
Just like standard cores, you can set Twin Cores by talking to NPC Sumina in the Enhancement Center after clearing the sub-quest "Enhancement Center".


You can get to the Enhancement Center from the southern border (on the State of Abul side).
You can also access it from YOME > Gear Enhancement > Core Set menu.

To set a Twin Core, you need two open core slots arranged in the same order as the Twin Core's colors.

Ex) Twin Core Red+Blue:
You need a core slot that's open in the order of Red+Blue.
*You can't set in a Blue+Red core slot.

Twin Core Red+Red:
You need a core slot that's open in the order of Red+Red.
*You can't set if the order is Red+Blue+Red, etc., where the colors are not next to each other.

notes.title: August 21 update details!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/967543233add383e4d4ab2e31a8ba392114c217a.jpg[/img]
We're announcing the contents of our August 21 update!

[h2]Update[/h2]
[h3]◆Raised the maximum limit breaks for some Mounts[/h3]
The maximum limit breaks for some Mounts has been raised from ★5 to ★7

[h3]Affected Mounts[/h3]
Chrome Emperor
Carrier Dragon
Black Fox
Robot
Pegasus
AW-DD4000T
Type 23 Tank
1700 Express
*Includes some Couple Drive Fest-limited Mounts.

[h3]Limit Break to ★6[/h3]
You need a ★5 Mount and the following materials to limit break to ★6.
・(Mount)'s S Med x1
・200,000 Zells

You can trade "(Mount)'s S Meds" with 10 "Sublimation Med Drops".

You can also get "Sublimation Med Drops" at Liz's Mystical Shop via the following methods.
・(Mount) Flute/Whistle x1 → "Sublimation Med Drop" x1
・(Mount) Miracle Drop x1x1 → "Sublimation Med Drop" x2

[h3]Limit Break to ★7[/h3]
You need a ★6 Mount and the following materials to limit break to ★7.
・Some "Area Bosses' drop material": (Area Boss) Soul Shard 4 types x75 each.
・"Divine Cinnabar" x100 that you can get by Dowsing in the Far Land.
・400,000 Zells

*The more difficult the Area Boss is, the more "(Area Boss) Soul Shards" will drop.

[Affected Area Bosses]
・Caliente: Caliente Soul Shard
・Dilitherio: Dilitherio Soul Shard
・Duroc: Duroc Soul Shard
・Ocypete: Ocypete Soul Shard

notes.title: New Area Boss! March 19 Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]New Area Boss "Buccaneer" arrives![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/368a7e52fef1d54f69d6895085baca3bc1f43d89.jpg[/img]

The powerful Area Boss - "Buccaneer" has appeared in the Underground Factory 5F!
Those who win the battles against the powerful Buccaneer might get materials and rare accessories...
Face this overwhelming power together with your friends!
*You need 3 Area Boss Tickets to fight.

[h2]Conditions[/h2]
・You must clear the quest "[N] New Organization"
・Your current job must be Lv 70 or above.
・You need 3 "Area Boss Tickets".
If you meet the above conditions, target the pillar of light placed in front of the Underground Factory in the "Village of Destruction". Select "Area Boss" from the menu.

[h2]Buccaneer Drop Items[/h2]
[h3]Rune Compatible Earrings[/h3]
You can carve Runes to the accessories that Buccaneer drops!
You can also create powerful Runes with the Rune materials that Buccaneer drops!

[h3]Magic Coin [Platinum][/h3]
You can use it to create special Runes.

[h3]Rune Materials[/h3]
Collect Buccaneer's materials and create powerful Runes.
*Deck in the Enhancement Center will exchange them for Runes.

[h3]Rune Ability examples[/h3]
・Boosts the ability that increases hate druing action
・Boosts the ability and boosts the ability even further according to the number of times skills are used
You'll have a chance get the above abilities and more!

Adds an effect which increases elemental DEF to "Aquarius" that has been enhanced by "Astral Sign"

◆Astral Sign
When the enhanced "Zodiac Sign" is being added, an equivalent buff effect triggers on all allies for 12 seconds at the time of a specific action
*The side to whom Zodiac Sign was added by this effect does not have the effect that enhances all allies.

◆Capricorn (Buff)
Adds "Capricorn" that has an effect that increases ATK/MATK on all allies when using an attacking skill

◆Aquarius (Buff)
Adds "Aquarius" that has an effect that increases elemental ATK on all allies when using an attacking skill
Adds "Aquarius" that has an effect that increases elemental DEF on all allies when using a buff skill

◆Libra (Buff)
Adds "Libra" that has an effect that increases DEF/MDEF on all allies when using a buff skill

◆Sagittarius (Buff)
Adds "Sagittarius" that has an effect that increases critical damage on all allies when using an attacking skill

【Kaiser】
◆Bursting Kick
Enhances ATK value
When using a skill, increases the number of attacks and reduces damage dealt
When "Finishing Touch - Dual" or "Finishing Touch-Supreme" is in effect, if you use "Supreme Fists" again within 10 seconds, an equivalent enhancement triggers as when using "Stage"

◆Supreme Fists
Enhances ATK value
Triggers extra damage according to ATK when using a skill
When "Finishing Touch - Dual" or "Finishing Touch-Supreme" is in effect, if you use "Bursting Kick" again within 10 seconds, an equivalent enhancement triggers as when using "Stage"

◆Finishing Touch Pose
Triggers extra damage according to ATK and increases damage limit to "Finishing Touch-Supreme" effect

◆Enhances by stages
Enhances the attacking skill when using "1st Stage" or "Stage"

【Nirvana】
◆Sage Spirit
Enhances the effect that increases damage limit every time when used (max 3 steps)

◆Heavenly Thunder
Enhances ATK value
When the 3rd stage of "Sage Spirit" is in effect, triggers extra damage according to wind ATK

◆Dragon Flash
Enhances ATK value
Adds the ability that ignores DEF
When the 3rd stage of "Sage Spirit" is in effect, triggers extra damage according to ATK or MATK, and increases damage limit according to ATK

notes.title: Teamwork! "Bond Hideouts" are here! December 20 Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/0b94e12e19282978a71e348eb37c60001af7dc22.jpg[/img]
[h2]What are "Hideouts"?[/h2]
This feature allows you and your Bond members to build your own Hideout.
You can also obtain Hideout EXP and Hideout Points by completing "Bond Quests", which are implemented at the same time as the Hideout feature.
The "Boost" function activates by using the "Hideout Points" and gives you various buff effects.
As your Hideout level increases, the amount of "Boost" buffs increases, and the rewards for "Bond Quests" change.


[h2]Hideout Information[/h2]
You can see HIdeout information from Menu > Interact > Bond.

[h3]Hideout Status[/h3]
You can check details about your Hideout.
Bond Name　　　　　　・・・Name of your current Bond
Hideout Level　　　　・・・Current Hideout level
HIdeouit Points　　　・・・HIdeout Points your Bond currently has
My Hideout Points　・・・My Hideout Points you currently have
Current EXP　　　　・・・Total of current Hideout EXP
Until Next Lv　　　・・・Amount of Hideout EXP required to level up
You can also check the Boosts you've learned at each level and those currently in effect.

[h3]Boost[/h3]
You can activate Boosts.
You can also check the Boosts that are currently activated.
Bond Quests
You can check details about Bond Quests.


[h2]What are "Boosts"?[/h2]
You can access Boosts from Menu > Interact > Hideout Information > Boost.
There are two types of Boosts: "Overall" and "Individual"
Overall Boost
You can activate up to 3 Boosts.
You need 100 Hideout Points to activate one Boost.
By activating the Boost, all Bond members will get the effects.
The Boost is activated for 24 hours.
Individual Boost
You can activate up to 3 Boosts.
You need My Hideout Points to activate a Boost.
You can activate one Boost for 1 hour with 10 My Hideout Points. (If you want to activate a Boost for a longer time, you are charged more points. )
You can activate them for up to 100 hours.

[h2]About the function to manage permissions to change Hideout boosts[12/27 Update][/h2]
You can check boost permissions via Menu> Interact> Bond> Change Permissions.
The bond leader can grant permission to activate Hideout boosts to each bond member.
*All members' permissions will be disabled as default.
*Permissions can be changed by the bond leader.

[h2]What are "Bond Quests"?[/h2]
You can access Bond Quests from Menu > Interact > Bond > Bond Quest.
There are weekly "Co-op Quests" that you can play with your Bond members, as well as daily "Solo Quests" that you can play by yourself.

[h3]Co-op Quests[/h3]
You can play the selected quest with your Bond members each week.
The quests and rewards you can get change by the Bond level.
*Co-op Quests update every Monday at 0:00 JST.
*The Bond level you have by Sunday at 20:00 JST will be reflected.
*The quest status will reset during the update.
*Even if there is a similar quest after the update, your previous progress will not be transferred.
*If a Mamono is defeated while being in the same party with the same Bond members, the progress level will not be duplicated.
*About new Bond members
┗The quest is automatically accepted from the next update after the member has joined.
┗New members won't get the rewards from the week they joined.
┗If you leave the Bond before receiving your reward and rejoin the same Bond, you will become a new Bond member and will not receive the reward for that week's Co-op Quest.

[h3]◆Co-op Quest Rewards[/h3]
Rewards can be received when the Bond Leader presses the receive button on the Co-op Quest list.
Hideout Points, Hideout EXP, and Bond Donations will be added to your Bond when you receive the rewards.
Other rewards will be sent to the Limited Time Reward Box.

[h3]Solo Quests[/h3]
Daily quests for Bond members to play by themselves.
Only the player who clears the quests can receive the rewards.
The rewards will be sent directly to your bag after pressing the receive button.
*About rejoining a Bond
┗If you leave the Bond and rejoin it before completing the Solo Quests or receiving the rewards, your status will be carried over.
┗If you leave the Bond after receiving the Solo Quest rewards and then rejoin the Bond, your Solo Quest status will be carried over.
┗Individual points you got before leaving the Bond will be carried over when you rejoin another Bond.

notes.title: Become even stronger! "Tower of Time: Night" is here! December 6 Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/9dd9528d60560691f26ba16ffd41a67b417db16c.jpg[/img]
[h2]What's "Tower of Time: Night"?[/h2]
It's a new solo feature where players can strengthen their rank 3 and extra jobs.
Together with your YOME, you can reach the higher floors while defeating enemies, which enables you to strengthen your status and skills.
Each floor's enhancement rewards can only be received once per week, and the acquisition history and achievements reset every Monday at 0:00 JST.

[h2]Conditions[/h2]
・You must have accepted the quest "Let's Climb The Tower!"
・You must clear the quest "Request for Cokes"
・Your current job must be Lv 90 or above.

When you move to the Tower of Time 1F while meeting the above conditions, you can accpet the exclusive quest "Tower of the Night".
After that, you can proceed from the movement point in the Tower of Time 2F to the Tower of Time: Night 1F. (*Only if your current job is at level 90)
After moving, the entrance to the next floor is closed, and you can only enter it by defeating the enemies there.

[h2]About "Tower of Time: Night"[/h2]
At the beginning of a battle, a damage restriction is added to the enemies in the Tower of Time: Night, preventing you from dealing more than a certain amount of damage.
Look for ways to relax or remove the restricition and be creative in how you fight to aim for bigger damage!
Also, you cannot revive during the battles at the Tower of Time: Night, so make sure to fight in cooperation with your YOME to avoid being defeated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/e1e614e2ebd1877444dd52707903c9f1c6cc740a.jpg[/img]
Damage restriction icon


[h2]Rewards[/h2]
By defeating the enemies on the regular floors, you can get "Time Skip Coin (Dusk)" , "Soul Shard", and "Coins" based on your current job.
You can get these once per week per floor.
In addition, at the boss floors located every fifth floor, when you win the battle and use "Soul Shard" you can get a "Soul" based on your current job.
Even if you go to the next floor without using a "Soul Shard", you can use it and get the "Soul" if you retry the battle.
*You can choose to use the "Soul Shard" only at the end of a battle if you win. There is no weekly limit to the rewards you can get when using it.

[h2]Passive Skill Acquistion, Item Trade[/h2]
The "Coin", "Soul", and "Time Skip Coin (Dusk)" you get can be traded for passive skills and items at the Merchant's Exchange in the Tower of Time 2F.
The passive skills enhance your status and also boost the effects when enhancing skills or getting buffs from your allies.
*You can trade passive skills only once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/95074044435d0bc3936eb37b40b234f9f6ab0525.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/967543233add383e4d4ab2e31a8ba392114c217a.jpg[/img]
[h2]Update[/h2]
・Added Limited Time Reward Box feature

【8/2 Edit】
※We have confirmed an issue that when the contents of the Limited Time Reward Box are on more than one page, the item at the bottom of the previous page appears on the next page when the item is received on the last page.

[h3]Limited Time Reward Box Feature[/h3]
This feature allows players to receive specific rewards that they were unable to receive due to disconnection or other reasons. The items will be stored for a certain period of time and the players will be able to receive them.

[h3]Rewards that can be stored[/h3]
・Reward for defeating a Boss in Party Dungeons
・Reward for defeating Mamonos in Tower of Time Basement
・Reward for defeating Area Bosses
・Reward for defeating Bosses in Spirit Wars

[h3]How to receive the rewards[/h3]
・After meeting the requirements for storing the reward, it can be received from the "Limited Time Box" icon.

[h3]Notes[/h3]
・You will not be able to receive the items after a certain period of time.
・Time will be counted during maintenance as well.
・Only rewards for defeating Mamonos will be stored. Quest rewards will not be stored.
・There is a limit to the number of items that can be stored in the Limited Time Reward Box. Once the limit is exceeded, the reward will not be stored even if the conditions are met.
If there are no items available in the Limited Time Reward Box, the icon for receiving items will not be displayed.

Death Bringers are death in a human form. They bring death to those who are destined to die.

*You can accept "About Rank 3 Jobs" after clearing the Main Quest Ch. 76 and Sub Quest "Tempting Astral Weapons".

*You can take the Pre-Test from NPC "Adventure Master" outside the Tower.

notes.title: New Rank 3 Job "Sorcerer" is Here! March 29 Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/8767925510b41ccb2139fe63b92a94c89e49869a.jpg[/img]
New Rank 3 Job [Sorcerer] Added!
Let's welcome a new rank 3 job, "Sorcerer"!
Those with secret knowledge. Deep mysteries follow the unknown elements.

[h2]Conditions to Accept Rank 3 Job Quests[/h2]
Players are required to meet the following conditions to accept rank 3 job quests.
・Level up the rank 2 job to Lv 70 and clear the quest "About Rank 3 Jobs". You can accept it from Kaho.
*You can accept "About Rank 3 Jobs" after clearing the Main Quest Ch. 76 and Sub Quest "Tempting Astral Weapons".
・After clearing "About Rank 3 Jobs", you must have an UR or LR Akashic Weapon to take the pre-test of each rank 3 job.
*You can take the Pre-Test from NPC "Adventure Master" outside the Tower.


[h3]About Sorcerer[/h3]
Those with secret knowledge. Deep mysteries follow the unknown elements.

[h3]Requirements to change your job to a Sorcerer[/h3]
◆Job Quest Requirements
・Clear "About Rank 3 Jobs"
・Pass the Pre-Test for Sorcerer
・Wizard Lv 70 or above
・You must have Akashic Weapon "Gnosis Avesta" or "Gnosis Avesta Ω"

◆Where to Change Jobs
Accept the job quest for "Sorcerer" from Kaho at the Tavern in the State of Abul. After clearing it you can change your job.

Introducing Sorcerer skills!
◆The Warth of Zeus
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/46904183382458b7a8fdb0a03b0b874ab245177a.png[/img]
Wind magic damage to all enemies. Boosted effect during A Burst.

◆Dynamis
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/9e287de0c9ec446e4c0db9b2a7956b5becc86ef3.png[/img]
Spirit magic damage to all enemies. No DEF. Boosted effect during A Burst.

◆Arcane
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/c6f6b4f88b65812c2c98a0b0075dc62721218f6e.png[/img]
Adds Arcane. Effect changes when used while Remnant activates.A Burst during M/E & stage 3 Whirl.
